final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.riskeval, AVG(1.0 * c.gbsize / NULLIF(c.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.riskeval), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS excess FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(excess) FROM step3
